Title: A novel ensemble learning framework based on a genetic algorithm for the classification of pneumonia - ScienceDirect
In this study, we propose a novel ensemble CNN framework to accurately detect pneumonia, with optimum weights set by a Genetic Algorithm (GA). Within the realm of medical image analysis, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), a subset of deep learning, are prominently utilized for disease detection (Litjens et al., 2017; Yamashita et al., 2018). Custom CNN models (Liang and Zheng, 2020; Stephen et al., 2019; Rajaraman et al., 2018; Saraiva et al., 2019), transfer learning (Jain et al., 2020; Salehi et al., 2021; Latif et al., 2021; Kermany et al., 2018; Moujahid et al., 2020; Ayan and Ünver, 2019), and ensemble learning (Chouhan et al., 2020; Vrbancic and Podgorelec, 2022; Hashmi et al., 2020; Livieris et al., 2019; Mabrouk et al., 2022) approaches are used to detect pneumonia from chest X-rays. In this study, an extensive experimental study has been carried out to establish the performance of CNN models at various noise levels in chest X-ray images (Kermany, et al.; Kermany et al., 2018), as well as their behavior under varied transfer learning circumstances and in imbalanced dataset situations. Since the ensemble learning approach can combine the benefits of multiple models, the proposed framework for pneumonia detection was thoroughly optimized. In the ensemble learning method, we have reached the optimum result that will minimize the loss and maximize the accuracy values of each model with the real-valued Genetic Algorithm (GA) (Haupt and Haupt, 2004; Kaya et al., 2021b) for the problem of which weights the models will contribute to the result. The reason for this work, however, was the lack of determining the best base CNN models and their weights to the ensemble learning method to detect pneumonia accurately. Custom CNN models, transfer of the weight of the existing models trained on the ImageNet and ensemble learning techniques were utilized to diagnose pneumonia on X-ray pictures. ### Pneumonia detection in chest X-ray images using convolutional neural networks and transfer learning. ### A novel transfer learning based approach for pneumonia detection in chest X-ray images. This study proposes a deep learning model for automatic OA classification from X-ray images, optimized using a Genetic Algorithm (GA) to enhance performance.
